name: Cañamero (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cañamero (a castle on white and a mount).
history: The arms and the flag of Cañamero were approved by the Order of 9 April 1991 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 16 April 1991, after the municipal council's approval on 19 July 1989.
